decisions.proposed_text: Khi điểm liên kết đạt 80 trở lên,\nTraining Effectiveness tăng
decisions.reason: Category 155 requires the established Support Effect label Training Effectiveness rather than a literal Vietnamese rendering.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded support.training_effectiveness.effect155 requires 训练效果提升→Training Effectiveness.

decisions.proposed_text: Khi điểm liên kết đạt 80 trở lên,\nSpeed Bonus
decisions.reason: Current text uses a mixed literal label Thưởng Speed instead of the established Support Effect label Speed Bonus.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded rules require 速度加成→Speed Bonus and 速度→Speed.

decisions.proposed_text: Năng lượng hiện tại càng nhiều,\nTraining Effectiveness càng cao
decisions.reason: Category 155 requires Training Effectiveness for 训练效果提升; the scaling meaning is preserved.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded support.training_effectiveness.effect155 requires 训练效果提升→Training Effectiveness.

decisions.proposed_text: Dựa theo số Skill tăng Speed đang có (tối đa 3),\nSpeed Bonus
decisions.reason: Skill and Speed are already canonical, but the Support Effect label must be Speed Bonus rather than Thưởng Speed.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded rules require 技能→Skill, 速度→Speed and 速度加成→Speed Bonus.

decisions.proposed_text: Khi điểm liên kết đạt 80 trở lên,\nSpecialty Priority tăng
decisions.reason: Current text uses the forbidden literal tỷ lệ sở trường instead of the established Support Effect label Specialty Priority.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded support.specialty_priority.effect155 requires 得意率提升→Specialty Priority.
